# Dirwell Font Fixture

This test-only 28,512-byte TrueType font is a renamed subset of Noto Sans TC, licensed under the accompanying SIL Open Font License. It is not a runtime default.

Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/3be1884c48c3e45b52ecc725676a08f87776373e/ofl/notosanstc/NotoSansTC%5Bwght%5D.ttf

Source SHA-256: `864727d210d54f2537bbe23b3a839436c3992af72de9322af5270897246bd44f`

Subset SHA-256: `bf0ced1f5663359315530ff10761a63e36346c0e2025bb1e2ab5eaa44e11baed`

Produced with FontTools 4.66.1: instantiate weight 400, retain ASCII U+0020–U+007E and characters in `繁體中文日本語字型測試資料下載檔案目錄分享画像こんにちは世界サンプル…`, subset with all name records, and rename family/full/PostScript/unique names to Dirwell Font Fixture (PostScript: DirwellFontFixture). Retain the original copyright/license records. This limited fixture intentionally does not provide general CJK coverage.
